name: Tiefling (2024)
description: Tieflings are either born in the Lower Planes or have fiendish ancestors who originated there, linking them by blood to a devil, a demon, or some other Fiend.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Otherworldly Presence
traits.description: You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip. When you cast it with this trait, the spell uses the same spellcasting ability you use for your Fiendish Legacy trait.

fiendish_legacies.name: Abyssal Legacy
fiendish_legacies.level_1_benefit: You have Resistance to Poison damage. You also know the Poison Spray cantrip.

fiendish_legacies.name: Chthonic Legacy
fiendish_legacies.level_1_benefit: You have Resistance to Necrotic damage. You also know the Chill Touch cantrip.

fiendish_legacies.name: Infernal Legacy
fiendish_legacies.level_1_benefit: You have Resistance to Fire damage. You also know the Fire Bolt cantrip.
